commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Adrian, who smothers the ball.
90+7' Betis quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+4' Marc Bartra (Betis) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
90+1' Juan Cruz (Leganes) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
89' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
87' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
85' Substitution. Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier leaves the pitch and is replaced by Duk (Leganes).
85' Borja Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) replacing Seydouba Cisse.
85' The substitution has been made. William Carvalho (Betis) has replaced Cucho Hernandez.
85' Darko Brasanac will be replaced by Julian Chicco (Leganes).
82' 2 - 3 Cucho Hernandez (Betis) scores a goal! He latches onto a lovely pass that puts him one-on-one with the keeper before producing a fine strike that goes into the left side of the net!
82' Juan Cruz (Leganes) steps up to send the ball in.
81' Isco (Betis) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
78' 2 - 2 Cedric Bakambu (Betis) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball low into the middle of the goal, and thus alter the score to 2:2.
77' Juan Cruz (Leganes) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
77' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
75' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Yvan Neyou (Leganes) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Oscar Rodriguez.
72' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
70' The referee allows time for a substitution. Diego Llorente will be replaced by Marc Bartra (Betis).
68' A goal, which was scored by Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes), was disallowed due to offside.
67' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
64' 2 - 1 Goal! Isco (Betis) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Marko Dmitrovic into the bottom left corner.
64' Isco (Betis) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

63' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Marko Dmitrovic (Leganes). Cesar Soto Grado saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Betis are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
62' A substitution has been made. Pablo Fornals is replaced by Cedric Bakambu (Betis).
62' Here is a change. Youssouf Sabaly is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Aitor Ruibal (Betis).
62' That will be all from Abde Ezzalzouli who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jesus Rodriguez (Betis).
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dani Raba trots off the pitch and is replaced by Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes).
58' Antony (Betis) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
57' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
56' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
55' Betis take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
55' Antony (Betis) fires the ball towards the right side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
54' 32:68 – the latest ball possession ratio.
52' The free kick from Isco (Betis) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out.
50' Antony (Betis) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
48' A cross from a corner kick by Betis is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
47' What a chance that is! Pablo Fornals (Betis) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
46' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' A cross by Cucho Hernandez (Betis) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
45+1' Antony (Betis) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the right post. Terrific solo effort, though.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' 2 - 0 Spectacular goal! Dani Raba (Leganes) brilliantly darts into the box to latch on to a cross and buries the ball into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper stunned!
43' Great solo effort from Antony (Betis)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort rose just over the bar.
42' The resulting corner from Antony (Betis) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
42' Romain Perraud (Betis) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
41' Isco (Betis) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
40' The Betis players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
38' Romain Perraud (Betis) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
38' Antony (Betis) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner and attempts to finish from the edge of the box. His shot, however, misses the target narrowly wide of the left post.
38' Betis win a corner.

37' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. Betis will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
37' Isco (Betis) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
35' Lovely cross from Antony to find Isco (Betis) deep in the box, but he steers his header well over the bar.
34' A rebound falls for Renato Tapia (Leganes), who immediately lets rip with a howitzer of a shot from distance. The effort, however, is bravely blocked by a defender.
33' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
32' Antony (Betis) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marko Dmitrovic intercepts the ball.

29' 1 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Dani Raba (Leganes) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 1:0. Adrian was helpless.
29' Isco (Betis) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
27' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
26' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
25' Antony (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
24' Juan Cruz (Leganes) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

23' That didn't go as planned! Javi Hernandez (Leganes) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom right corner was too weak to get past Adrian, who easily kept it out.
22' Sergi Altimira (Betis) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
20' Darko Brasanac (Leganes) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent. Betis are awarded a free kick.
19' Dani Raba (Leganes) and Juan Cruz try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
18' A pass by Romain Perraud (Betis) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
17' Marko Dmitrovic displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Isco (Betis) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
16' A raking crossfield pass from Yvan Neyou (Leganes) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
14' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
13' Isco (Betis) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
12' Darko Brasanac (Leganes) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
10' Isco (Betis) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Marko Dmitrovic has no trouble gathering it.
9' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Antony (Betis), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
8' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
6' Pablo Fornals (Betis) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
5' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender.
3' Cesar Soto Grado couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Sergi Altimira (Betis) and blew his whistle. Leganes are awarded the free kick.

2' That didn't go as planned! Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Marko Dmitrovic, who easily kept it out.
